status.freshDesc: Data is within the expected update cadence
status.delayedDesc: Data is delayed (1.5x-3x the expected interval)
status.staleDesc: Data is stale (over 3x the expected interval); interpret with caution
status.emptyDesc: Collected successfully, but the source returned nothing (e.g. no events this period, no news in the window)
status.missingDesc: Dataset has never been produced; normal content is hidden
status.degradedDesc: Some providers degraded/fell back; model confidence has been reduced
status.cacheReplayDesc: Served from the last-good cache, not fetched live; treat as stale

error.title: Failed to load data
error.message: Could not fetch or validate the data file. Please try again later.

empty.title: No data yet
empty.message: This data source has not produced data yet

footer.disclaimer: The risk score is a modeled estimate of market stress (based on historical data and current market signals). It is not a definitive probability or investment advice.
footer.calibration: See the calibration report for methodology and validation.
